careItems.title: Light & Placement
careItems.desc: Understanding your tree's relationship with light is the foundation of good bonsai care. Most species thrive with bright, indirect outdoor exposure.

careItems.title: Watering Rhythms
careItems.desc: Bonsai ask to be observed, not scheduled. Learn to read the soil, the leaves, the season — and water only when truly needed.

careItems.title: Pruning & Wiring
careItems.desc: Shaping a bonsai is a conversation between artist and tree. We'll walk you through the tools, timing, and techniques that define the form.
